title: Juniper Security Advisories - 2026-07-01
description:
Merged 2 juniper security advisories published on 2026-07-01. Original advisory IDs: JSA110086, JSA110085

Titles:
- JSA110086 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS: MX Series with SPC3, SRX Series: Processing of a specifically malformed SIP invite causes a flowd crash (CVE-2026-57026)
- JSA110085 : 2026-07 Security Bulletin: Junos OS and Junos OS Evolved: EX Series, QFX Series, MX Series: A specific 'show l2-learning/ethernet-switching' command causes l2ald crash (CVE-2026-57025)
